## Independent assessment

The actual diff realizes approved Design r8 and Delivery r5 M3. Exactly seven living model declarations, the current boundary-method reference, Design-owned transition/example, published model authoring guidance, skeleton, validator/tests and measured current candidate metadata agree on model-document-v1. Runtime rigorloop-records-v2 and targeted-recording-v1, stored historical records, unrelated installer code, existing feature grammar and structural model rules are unchanged. The one retired marker is rejected rather than retained as a competing alias. Installation grants no permission to change project documents; the explicit owner-authorized edit and coherent rollback contract remain visible.

The validator strips non-live fenced/comment content before finding declarations, then requires exactly one accepted marker and returns BFR-MODEL-CONTRACT before any table checks for retired, unknown, missing or duplicate declarations. No closed-vocabulary fallthrough was added. The actionable error names the current marker. Required section, dimension, local-reference, path and non-applicability checks retain their earlier protection. New regressions distinguish old-marker acceptance from current-marker acceptance and explicitly test rejection before malformed-table handling; they add coverage without deleting negative cases. The independently executed 12 ModelRecordTests passed, including current seven-model selection, historical flat path behavior, no activation, symlink/path rejection, missing/duplicate/unknown declarations and fenced/indented nonauthority.

The indexed label-normalization record is complete for the structural example claim: three locally owned requirements, eight dimensions, meaningful non-applicability, ASCII-space and error outcomes, purity/idempotence, and explicit synthetic responsibility/path. It is not an adopted component, stored record or implementation success claim. Parent and extraction both validate; the fence does not become a second parent declaration. Exact example-plus-owner reassessment remains required under DES-SR-12/16. The selective installed MW-01 refresh independently exercised all three archive resource sets, populated installed skeletons in disposable customer fixtures, distinguished missing project authority from installation guidance, and demonstrated changed-example/unchanged-owner handoff without automatic invalidation or migration.

## Evidence and derived currency

All subjects in design-review-r8, delivery-review-r5, model-marker-m3-checks, mw-03-model-marker-candidate and mw-01-model-marker-refresh match current file hashes. I inspected their actual scope and complete M3 diff, not only their pass labels. Current archive SHA/size match measured metadata: Codex c5e5614a247db15530d37e5a2666f99df5fec2d288bd3c5c9cb63d717f33bf1b /277103; Claude5f0eba245c45024e2a83b19b8c744998414f70e3f7cc395fb230cca2e5ae8172 /276420; OpenCode12fdb726852a436e27009f0fbe84ecd115df4740215efb7f7c8ee7260c19cb0e /279259. The current bundled metadata digest was regenerated accordingly; historical release entries are unchanged.

Independent MW-01 byte comparison found identical archive entry sets and only the model-authoring resource and Design skeleton changed in each target. This permits bounded reuse of unchanged legacy-feature/architecture/ADR, shared-contract and installed-method assessments; it does not retarget earlier archive executions. The new actual MW-03 report instead exercises current-candidate identity through public managed replacement, interruption, partial-retry rejection, backup restoration, coherent success/idempotence and preservation of the old managed neighbor. Installer implementation is unchanged and the fresh public report is distinct from the synthetic semantic fixture.

Author evidence records tests-first two-case failure on old dispatch, then 89 boundary,355 skill,454 Node and7 npm-publication tests; selected maintained checks and clean installs of all3 candidates passed. I independently ran python3 scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py ModelRecordTests:12 passed. I did not rerun or claim fresh full158 adapter tests; unchanged engine/method bytes and fresh generation/install/metadata proof support the stated limited reuse. The13 original installer prose failures remain explicit historical baseline debt outside this marker change, not a universal prose waiver. Existing earlier Verify is preserved as historical evidence and supplies no current final readiness.

## Checklist and limits

Contract alignment, meaningful proof, input/error/fence boundaries, architecture ownership, intentional marker compatibility, project authorization, derived currency, narrow scope, preservation and sufficient milestone validation pass. No material finding is supported. Prior concern origins/dispositions remain untouched. No source edit, workflow routing, final whole-change approval, Verify result, hosted CI, publication, customer adoption or PR push is claimed.

Independent nonauthor /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent authored M3 production, Design and Delivery changes under explicit user direction.
